lines.intro_zh: 阿强：老师，我让您三分？……开玩笑的，来吧！
lines.intro_en: Ah Qiang: Shall I spot you three points? Kidding. Let's go!
lines.win_zh: 阿强：老师您这杀球……下周我还要来！

wu.level_zh: 化学系博士后 · 校队

lines.intro_en: Xiao Wu: So physics sent a professor. I won't go easy.
lines.win_zh: 小吴：……好吧，物理系赢了。今晚的奶茶我请。

lines.lose_zh: 小吴：化学系拿下！教授打得不错，就是步子慢了点。

lines.rematchWon_zh: 小吴：上次是我状态不好。

lines.rematchLost_en: Xiao Wu: Back for more points?

lines.win_zh: 阿杰：wah，教授厉害！下次请你吃炒粿条。
lines.win_en: Jay: Wah, Prof, not bad! Char kway teow on me next time.
lines.lose_zh: 阿杰：教授，跟上我的节奏先啦！

lines.rematchWon_zh: 阿杰：上次是我太嚣张了。今天认真打。

autoWin._comment: win chance for 'just play it out', linear in energy; set a little below the bot runs in DESIGN.md so that playing pays

lines_zh: 跑位是自动的，你只管出手。脚下的外圈收紧到内圈、变绿时松手，就是最佳时机。
上滑：高远球 · 下滑：吊球 / 放网 · 左右滑：平抽 · 球在头顶时点一下：杀球。
斜着滑选角：左上 / 右上打两个后场角，左下 / 右下打两个前场角。
后场球：先按住再滑是马来步（转身用正手，要时间够）；双击再滑是中国跳（不转身，抢点更早，费体力）。
电脑：W/S/A/D、Q/E/Z/C、空格；K = 马来步，L = 中国跳；? 随时看这一页。体力越低，判定越窄。
lines_en: Movement is automatic: you only swing. Release as the outer ring closes on the inner one and turns green.
Swipe up: clear · down: drop / net shot · left/right: drive · tap when it's overhead: smash.
Swipe diagonally to pick a corner: up-left / up-right for the rear corners, down-left / down-right for the front.
Rear-court balls: hold, then swipe for the Malaysian step (turn, forehand, needs time); double-tap, then swipe for the China jump (no turn, earlier, costs energy).
Keyboard: W/S/A/D, Q/E/Z/C, Space; K = Malaysian step, L = China jump; ? shows this page. The more tired you are, the tighter the timing.
